study_boundary: BBMP municipal footprint (~711 sq km, 12.833-13.142N 77.462-77.786E) as the city denominator; Bangalore Urban district (East, North, South, Anekal taluks) as the wider frame. Taluk evidence stays labelled taluk.

include_domains: aquifer geometry, disposition, boundaries, thickness, weathered zones, fractured zones, and productive depths
groundwater levels, monitoring wells, seasonal and long-term trends
groundwater resource assessment, recharge, extraction, stress, and status
groundwater quality, sampling locations, parameters, exceedances, and trends
exploratory wells, piezometers, pumping tests, and borehole logs that directly characterize aquifers or groundwater
supporting_evidence: geology, lithology, structure, soils, or land use only when directly required to interpret aquifer geometry, recharge, groundwater flow, quality, or well depths
exclude_domains: general geology or lineament mapping without a direct aquifer or groundwater role
standalone soil mapping without recharge, infiltration, groundwater-quality, or aquifer relevance
seismic hazard, deformation, and microzonation without a direct groundwater relationship
metro, utility, tunnel, and infrastructure studies without groundwater observations or aquifer evidence

evidence_gaps: recent located groundwater-level observations and trends
current groundwater resource status and extraction stress
aquifer-characterization wells, fractures, yields, and pumping-test evidence

source_policy.older_dynamic_evidence: exclude from acquisition and selection; record only as an unresolved or historical lead
source_policy.older_stable_evidence: exclude from acquisition and selection; record only as an unresolved lead and search for an in-window successor
